paper_facing_name: Event-Triggered Mixed-Integer MPC with Causal Domain Reduction
implementation_acceleration: Persistent model reoptimization with causal MIP warm starts
online_problem_relation: Same objective, hard constraints, H54 horizon, causal inputs, and physical semantics; restricted online discrete decision domain

domain_reduction_layers.exact_safe: Only choices proven infeasible or K3 duration-energy dominated are removed without approximation
domain_reduction_layers.bounded_approximation: Remaining feasible route and workload options are causally ranked and truncated to the frozen January-development K

candidate_k_freeze_rule: Choose once using January runtime-versus-oracle-gap results; never refit on February, March, or April
persistent_update_scope: route availability, ETA, energy, and location coefficients
RHS, bounds, and sparse coefficients only

prohibited: acceptance with an unresolved line, transformer, or PCS norm violation
milp_circle_authority.acceptance: Every accepted MILP incumbent must pass vectorized exact Euclidean-norm separation at the frozen numerical tolerance
milp_circle_authority.timeout: Fail closed or execute a previously Fresh-AC-certified fallback; never commit an unseparated incumbent

lexicographic_objectives: min sum_h z_h * delta_t subject to the accepted priority-1 incumbent
min secondary actuation subject to accepted priorities 1 and 2
hard_constraints_unchanged: MESS route, connection, travel energy, SOC, charge/discharge mode, and PCS P-Q circle
GPU gang, rack, IDC transformer, WAN, checkpoint, and deadline
online_certificate_prohibitions: oracle result use in the online loop
objective or hard-limit relaxation for latency
